scope: P20-PRE AI-simulated INTERNAL scientific review; not human peer review or institutional approval
conclusions: All three recommend MAJOR_REVISION_REQUIRED for the manuscript. No local concern marked blocking=true; publication/narrative readiness differs from the validity of the narrow descriptive case study. No original reviewer item was changed or closed.
review_boundary: Only GitHub-committed reports and available repository files checked in this continuation. Original 80 copied local packet files are git-ignored and unavailable to this reviewer for full local-validator execution. A/B first frozen post-push, reviewer C previously frozen. Process-level isolation is described in dispatch but not externally proven.

concerns.topic: Development OOF/diversity/voting quantitative evidence absent from approved manuscript
concerns.why_it_matters: Claims discuss development OOF, diversity, voting (including negative results), but bounded PDF omits corresponding selected numerical exhibits.
concerns.acceptance_test: Create a separately reviewed source-linked companion with development OOF base-model, pairwise-diversity and voting tables, preserving all negative values and distinguishing DEVELOPMENT-only metrics from official TEST; request permission before changing the approved PDF.

concerns.topic: Approved 37-page PDF states P15 full TRAIN not reconstructed, but later audit records 3 accepted local artifacts
concerns.why_it_matters: The PDF was written against an earlier snapshot; newer P15 status must be reconciled in a dated companion without claiming original historical binary identity.
concerns.acceptance_test: Date-stamp a P15 addendum referring to 3 run reports and 69/69 author-host artifact checks, explicitly distinguish rebuilt TRAIN-only artifacts from historical originals; do not edit accepted PDF without author approval.

concerns.topic: Frozen 17-feature selection lineage/preprocessing/configuration insufficiently explained in manuscript
concerns.why_it_matters: Methods should trace stability selection, categorical preprocessor and frozen hyperparameters; RF17 vs RF42 is pipeline comparison not isolated feature-count causality.
concerns.acceptance_test: Provide source-anchored lineage with 17 ordered feature names, selection rules, seeds, exact categorical processing, chosen hyperparameters and pre-CV selection limits; no model fit/reselection.

concerns.topic: Originality and contribution framing relative to closest prior methods
concerns.why_it_matters: A bounded IDS benchmark/error/cost audit is evidenced; algorithmic novelty or field-wide SOTA is not.
concerns.acceptance_test: Prepare a claim-to-source comparison with L06/L12/N02 and reading-scope flags; state methodological components are prior art and highlight qualified empirical contribution without declaring superiority across unmatched protocols.

concerns.topic: Bootstrap stratification, statistical estimand and comparison family reporting
concerns.why_it_matters: Explain benchmark-row stratified joint patterns, percentile intervals, Holm family and inferential unit; failure to reject is not equivalence.
concerns.acceptance_test: Add source-checked statistical-methods companion with actual bootstrap unit/resampling mechanism, multiplicity family and non-equivalence warning; never recompute official results.

concerns.topic: Batch-average prediction time must not be marketed as per-request deployment latency
concerns.why_it_matters: The measured ms/sample is batch computation average under one environment; not online end-to-end latency.
concerns.acceptance_test: Correct captions/defense wording in companion to batch-average pipeline inference including preprocessing/label transformation and historical environment uncertainty.

concerns.topic: Diagram/list sequence can imply TEST opened before frozen selection
concerns.why_it_matters: Distinguish early dataset file integrity/inventory from fitting, development selection and one-time holdout evaluation.
concerns.acceptance_test: Add chronology diagram tied to actual source and frozen plan; do not claim TEST was never read for audit, only that TEST not used for tuning; no historical rewriting.

concerns.topic: Within-partition duplicates and label-conflict sensitivity not fully quantified in manuscript
concerns.why_it_matters: Cross-split overlap and within-split repetitions have separate meanings; neither proves complete absence of leakage.
concerns.acceptance_test: Link duplicate count/group and label-conflict source tables in appendix, retain caveat about flow/session dependence and do not delete flows retrospectively.

concerns.topic: Attack-family uncertainty and small-support classes underrepresented in compact report table
concerns.why_it_matters: A grouped table can hide subgroup differences; the existing Wilson intervals and nine-family sample sizes should remain available.
concerns.acceptance_test: Create companion full nine-family support/FN/miss-rate/Wilson table linked to saved source, mark sparse support and no multiclass claim.
